interpretation_limits: The original failed open errno was not captured. Its failed-open branch is identified from the exact matching loaded library and reproduced trap address; independent namespace observations show the incompatible IDs directly.
No unsupported environment option or syscall interposition is used as a workaround. The native macOS runtime still requires separate validation.
The libc CPU-clock control supports retaining that measurement; it does not qualify every CPU clock or prove freedom from unrelated runtime faults.
The terminating diagnostic signal observer only reports the loaded image/offset then exits; it does not resume execution.
A separate synchronous MainActor diagnostic was exploratory only and is excluded because it does not service the same asynchronous task cleanup.
